decision: Set core.hooksPath to tracked .husky via own prepare script instead of husky's default .husky/_; drop husky dependency
why: Reproduced gap: husky generates untracked, gitignored .husky/_ per checkout; core.hooksPath is shared across worktrees, so a new worktree points at a missing .husky/_ and git silently skips all hooks (bad commit message accepted) until pnpm install runs there. Pointing at the tracked .husky makes hooks exist the moment a worktree is created. Deviates from husky default (our design)
evidence: fresh clone + new worktree on main 2ec2f66: worktree commit 'bad message wt' accepted with hooksPath=.husky/_ and no .husky/_ dir; clone after pnpm install rejected it
result: decided; verification follows in a second row; rollback = restore prepare=husky and the husky devDependency
